# dstack

> dstack is an open-source control plane for GPU provisioning and orchestration across GPU clouds, Kubernetes, and on-prem clusters.

## Getting started

- [Overview](https://dstack.ai/docs/index.md): Introduction to dstack and how it works
- [Installation](https://dstack.ai/docs/installation.md): How to install the dstack server and CLI
- [Quickstart](https://dstack.ai/docs/quickstart.md): Quick guide to creating fleets and submitting runs

## Concepts

- [Backends](https://dstack.ai/docs/concepts/backends.md): Configuring cloud providers and Kubernetes clusters
- [Fleets](https://dstack.ai/docs/concepts/fleets.md): Managing pools of compute instances
- [Dev environments](https://dstack.ai/docs/concepts/dev-environments.md): Provisioning remote instances for cloud-based development
- [Tasks](https://dstack.ai/docs/concepts/tasks.md): Running commands for training and batch processing
- [Services](https://dstack.ai/docs/concepts/services.md): Deploying models and web apps as endpoints
- [Volumes](https://dstack.ai/docs/concepts/volumes.md): Managing persistent data storage

### More

- [Gateways](https://dstack.ai/docs/concepts/gateways.md): Managing ingress traffic and endpoints for services
- [Secrets](https://dstack.ai/docs/concepts/secrets.md): Managing sensitive values and credentials
- [Projects](https://dstack.ai/docs/concepts/projects.md): Organizing teams and isolating resources
- [Metrics](https://dstack.ai/docs/concepts/metrics.md): Tracking and monitoring system metrics
- [Events](https://dstack.ai/docs/concepts/events.md): Auditing resource state changes and operations
- [Exports](https://dstack.ai/docs/concepts/exports.md): Exporting resources across projects

## Guides

- [Server deployment](https://dstack.ai/docs/guides/server-deployment.md): Deploying the dstack server
- [Troubleshooting](https://dstack.ai/docs/guides/troubleshooting.md): Common issues and how to resolve them
- [Protips](https://dstack.ai/docs/guides/protips.md): Tips and tricks for using dstack efficiently
- [Upgrade](https://dstack.ai/docs/guides/upgrade.md): Upgrading to newer versions of dstack

### Migration

- [Slurm](https://dstack.ai/docs/guides/migration/slurm.md): This guide compares Slurm and dstack, and shows how to orchestrate equivalent GPU-based workloads using dstack.

## Examples

- [Examples](https://dstack.ai/examples.md): Collection of examples for training, inference, and clusters

### Single-node training

- [TRL](https://dstack.ai/examples/single-node-training/trl/index.md): Fine-tuning Llama with TRL using SFT and QLoRA
- [Axolotl](https://dstack.ai/examples/single-node-training/axolotl/index.md): Fine-tuning models with Axolotl using FSDP and QLoRA

### Distributed training

- [TRL](https://dstack.ai/examples/distributed-training/trl/index.md): Distributed fine-tuning with TRL, Accelerate, and DeepSpeed
- [Axolotl](https://dstack.ai/examples/distributed-training/axolotl/index.md): Distributed fine-tuning with Axolotl and FSDP across multiple nodes
- [Ray+RAGEN](https://dstack.ai/examples/distributed-training/ray-ragen/index.md): Multi-node agent fine-tuning using RAGEN with Ray and verl for reinforcement learning

### Clusters

- [AWS](https://dstack.ai/examples/clusters/aws/index.md): High-performance distributed training on AWS using Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA)
- [GCP](https://dstack.ai/examples/clusters/gcp/index.md): Creating and using GPU clusters on GCP with GPUDirect-TCPX and RoCE support
- [Lambda](https://dstack.ai/examples/clusters/lambda/index.md): Setting up Lambda clusters using Kubernetes or 1-Click Clusters with fast interconnect
- [Crusoe](https://dstack.ai/examples/clusters/crusoe/index.md): Using Crusoe clusters with InfiniBand support via VMs or Kubernetes
- [Nebius](https://dstack.ai/examples/clusters/nebius/index.md): Using Nebius clusters with InfiniBand support via VMs or Kubernetes
- [NCCL/RCCL tests](https://dstack.ai/examples/clusters/nccl-rccl-tests/index.md): Running NCCL and RCCL tests to validate cluster network bandwidth

### Inference

- [SGLang](https://dstack.ai/examples/inference/sglang/index.md): Deploying DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama models using SGLang on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs
- [vLLM](https://dstack.ai/examples/inference/vllm/index.md): Deploying Llama 3.1 8B using vLLM with OpenAI-compatible API
- [TGI](https://dstack.ai/examples/inference/tgi/index.md): Deploying Llama 4 Scout using HuggingFace Text Generation Inference
- [NIM](https://dstack.ai/examples/inference/nim/index.md): Deploying DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B using NVIDIA NIM
- [TensorRT-LLM](https://dstack.ai/examples/inference/trtllm/index.md): Deploying DeepSeek R1 and distilled models using NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM with Triton

### Accelerators

- [AMD](https://dstack.ai/examples/accelerators/amd/index.md): Deploying and fine-tuning models on AMD MI300X GPUs using TGI, vLLM, and Axolotl
- [TPU](https://dstack.ai/examples/accelerators/tpu/index.md): Deploying and fine-tuning models on Google Cloud TPUs using Optimum TPU and vLLM
- [Intel Gaudi](https://dstack.ai/examples/accelerators/intel/index.md): Deploying and fine-tuning models on Intel Gaudi accelerators using TGI, vLLM, and Optimum
- [Tenstorrent](https://dstack.ai/examples/accelerators/tenstorrent/index.md): Running dev environments, tasks, and services on Tenstorrent Wormhole accelerators

### Models

- [Wan2.2](https://dstack.ai/examples/models/wan22/index.md): Text-to-video generation using the Wan2.2 T2V-A14B foundational video model
